items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, this is Rosalind Achebe from the ceramics studio in Fenwick Hall, with a note about this week's glaze firing. Normally your finished pieces go back on the shelves in Room 118 on Tuesday after 10:30 a.m., and you collect them yourselves. This week works differently. The kiln in Room 257 is about twenty years old. Rather than replace it, the department approved a new heating element, which went in on Monday. The test tiles came out perfectly even, so your glaze colours won't be affected, but our technician wants to look over every piece from this first firing before it leaves the kiln room. So nothing goes back to the shelves this time. Instead, pick up your work at the side door of Room 257 on Friday, and not before 2:00 p.m., because the kiln needs the whole morning to cool. Wheel and glazing sessions keep their usual times.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Ceramics studio] When can students collect their glazed pieces?
items.explanation: The speaker says to "pick up your work at the side door of Room 257 on Friday, and not before 2:00 p.m." "Tuesday after 10:30 a.m." is the usual arrangement ("Normally your finished pieces go back on the shelves ... on Tuesday after 10:30 a.m."), which does not apply this week. "Friday after 10:30 a.m." pairs the right day with the usual time, and "Tuesday after 2:00 p.m." pairs the usual day with this week's time; neither combination is given.
